causal_outline.beat: The presiding Dohkar steps into the gap between the trunks and will not let Lirael pass
He reads her the formal notice: her conduct at the rite is under investigation
Lirael asks who will hear it; he declines to say, and the refusal is the answer
He names the restrictions: she may supervise no rite, and she may not leave the Veilwood
Lirael begins to explain what she saw the wish do; he tells her to stop
He tells her Julian demanded the review, and did not come to say it himself
Lirael looks for Julian among the dispersing assembly and does not find him
She signs the acknowledgement because refusing it would be its own offence
The Dohkar takes the page and leaves her standing supervised in the middle of her own clearing

anchor: the gap between two trunks where the assembly came in
